last_run.task: Begin B002 by creating a provenance-enforced baseline indicator model and seeding authoritative baselines for poverty, health-service coverage, electricity access, and clean cooking access.
last_run.why_selected: The repository had extensive governance/evaluation scaffolding but almost no substantive quantitative world-state data. A reusable indicator schema plus authoritative seed records increases grounding and makes future baseline expansion mechanically safer.

Extended scripts/validate_repo.py to validate indicator IDs, problem references, values, provenance, source types, limitations, review dates, and URLs
last_run.evaluation: All four records use authoritative institutional sources and explicitly record methodological/interpretive limitations. The pre-existing CI run after adding indicator data passed before indicator-specific validation was introduced. CI for the final validator commit was queued when this run checkpoint was written, so final success is intentionally not claimed yet.
